rejectedShortcut.proposal: Resolve the existing source host twice and compare the returned value, with no real projection observation.
rejectedShortcut.counterexample: The original renewal-source-fixture resolver returns an immutable sourceRefs array after access flags. A real Planner CAS can change the original source while both resolves still return the same old evidence. The revised ref alone performs a fresh projection read; originals still fall back to the static resolver.
rejectedShortcut.decision: Rejected. Preserve two authenticated canonical projection observations for every no-op base, including original refs.

contractReasoning: createPlannerOperationVerifier documents verification of operation targets and replacement amount references. Strict operations=[] and assumptions=[] have no such targets or premises. This own fixture helper returns admission only; it must not issue a financial result or C10 completeness.

The canonical projectPlannerSource remains the only projector. The fixture repeats the existing host.authenticate/roleMap/access-to-Actor wiring for two real persistence transactions; no financial expression, cost aggregate or classification is copied.

The complete reference envelope, digest, installation/project, surface/type/versionId, exact fields, whole-month period and projection year are validated against fresh snapshots. Both source resolves remain, and the full selected value is compared after cloning.

The second source resolution and external host revalidation occur BEFORE the second authenticated snapshot. Because authenticate is also asynchronous, the final observe performs one more host revalidation after authenticate and BEFORE projectPlannerSource, inside the final transaction. No asynchronous callback runs after that projection; return checks only synchronous request identity, binding digest and abort. Source drift introduced by external revalidate #2 and authority revocation introduced by authenticate #2 are separately refused.

Every request with operations OR assumptions still delegates to the existing canonical operation verifier. Every decision calculation, baseline assessment, C10 registry read, criterion, comparison and preview retains its current producer and fences.

The fourth preparePhase comparison exposes only value.candidate as a DomainProjection. It can use the already existing sourcePlanner, whose FinancialAnalysis completeness is deliberately not consumed there.
proofBoundary: The original source refs and scope declarations remain explicit synthetic fixture inputs. This proposal does not establish a native source issuer, loaded skill, installation session or human/browser journey.
No result, grant, projection or evidence cache survives a call. Each later admission observes again.
The observer does not validate financial completeness or generate monetary observations. Those obligations remain with the unchanged Planner and C10 consumers.
No expected performance gain is claimed. Only hosted negative tests and the complete180000ms history can qualify the candidate.
